verses.text: Since plenty people don try arrange account about those things wey don happen among us,
just as di people wey be eyewitnesses from di beginning and servants of di word hand dem over to us,
e seem good to me too, as I don trace all things carefully from di start, to write am for you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
so that you go know di certainty of di things wey dem teach you.
For di days of Herod, king of Judea, one priest dey wey im name na Zacharias, for di priestly division of Abijah. E get wife from Aaron daughters, and di woman name na Elizabeth.
Dem two dey righteous before God, dey waka blameless for all di commandments and rules of di Lord.
But dem no get pikin, because Elizabeth no fit born pikin, and dem two don old plenty.
Now while e dey do im work as priest before God as im division turn reach,
as di custom of di priest work be, dem choose am by lot to enter di temple of di Lord and burn incense.
All di crowd of di people dey pray outside for di hour of incense.
One angel of di Lord appear to am, dey stand for di right side of di altar of incense.
Zacharias trouble as e see am, and fear catch am.
But di angel talk to am say, “No fear, Zacharias, because dem don hear your request, and your wife Elizabeth go born son for you, and you go call im name John.
You go get joy and gladness; and plenty people go rejoice for im birth.
Because e go great before di Lord, and e no go drink wine or strong drink. Holy Spirit go fill am, even from im mama womb.
E go turn plenty of Israel pikin dem back to di Lord, dem God.

E go waka before am with di spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn di hearts of di papa dem to di pikin dem,’ and di people wey no obey to di wisdom of di just; to make ready people wey dem don prepare for di Lord.”
Zacharias talk to di angel say, “How I go take know this for sure? Because I don old, and my wife don old plenty.”
Di angel answer am, “I be Gabriel, wey dey stand for God presence. Dem send me to talk to you, and to bring you this Good News.
Look, you go dey quiet and no fit talk, until di day wey these things go happen, because you no believe my words, wey go fulfill for dem proper time.”
Di people dey wait for Zacharias, and dem dey marvel say e dey delay for di temple.
When e come out, e no fit talk to dem, and dem know say e don see vision for di temple. E dey make signs to dem, and e remain dumb.
As di days of im service finish, e go back im house.
After these days im wife Elizabeth get belle, and e hide five months, dey talk say,
“Na so di Lord do for me for di days wey e look me, to take away my shame among men.”
Now for di sixth month, dem send angel Gabriel from God go one town for Galilee wey dem call Nazareth,
to one virgin wey dem don promise to marry one man wey im name na Joseph, from David house. Di virgin name na Mary.
As e enter, di angel talk to am say, “Rejoice, you wey get plenty favor! Di Lord dey with you. Blessed be you among women!”
But when e see am, e trouble well well for di word, and e dey think wetin kind greeting this fit be.
Di angel talk to am say, “No fear, Mary, because you don find favor with God.
Look, you go get belle, born son, and you go call im name ‘Jesus.’
E go great, and dem go call am Pikin of di Most High. Di Lord God go give am di throne of im papa David,
and e go rule over di house of Jacob forever. Im kingdom no go ever end.”
Mary talk to di angel say, “How this go take be, since I be virgin?”
Di angel answer am, “Holy Spirit go come on you, and di power of di Most High go cover you. So di holy one wey go born from you go dey called God Pikin.
Look, Elizabeth, your relative, don get belle for one son for im old age too; and na di sixth month be this for di one wey dem dey call woman wey no fit born.
Because everything wey God talk, e possible.”
Mary talk, “Look, I na di servant of di Lord; make e happen to me as you talk.” Di angel leave am.
Mary get up for those days, go di hill country quick, go one town of Judah,
and enter Zacharias house and greet Elizabeth.
As Elizabeth hear Mary greeting, di baby jump inside im belle, and Holy Spirit fill Elizabeth.
E shout with loud voice, talk say, “Blessed be you among women, and blessed be di fruit of your belle!
Why I dey so favored, say di mama of my Lord come meet me?
Because look, as di voice of your greeting enter my ears, di baby jump inside my belle for joy.
Blessed be di one wey believe, because wetin dem talk to am from di Lord go fulfill!”
Mary talk say, “My soul dey praise di Lord greatly.
My spirit don rejoice for God my Savior,
because e don look di humble condition of im servant. Because look, from now, all generations go call me blessed.
Because di one wey mighty don do great things for me. Holy na im name.
Im mercy dey for generation after generation on di people wey fear am.
E don show strength with im arm. E don scatter di proud for di thoughts of dem heart.
E don bring down princes from dem thrones, and e don lift up di lowly.
E don fill di hungry with good things. E don send di rich go with empty hand.
E don help Israel, im servant, so that e go remember mercy,
as e talk to our papa dem, to Abraham and im seed forever.”
Mary stay with Elizabeth about three months, den e go back to im own house.
Now di time reach wey Elizabeth go born, and e born son.
Im neighbors and im relatives hear say di Lord don show am great mercy, and dem rejoice with am.
For di eighth day, dem come circumcise di pikin; and dem wan call am Zacharias, after im papa name.
Im mama answer, “No be so; e go dey called John.”
Dem talk to am say, “Nobody among your relatives dey called by this name.”
Dem make signs to im papa, to ask wetin name e want make dem call am.
E ask for writing tablet, write, “Im name na John.” Dem all marvel.
At once im mouth open, im tongue loose, and e talk, dey bless God.
Fear catch all di people wey dey live round dem, and dem talk about all these things through all di hill country of Judea.
All di people wey hear dem keep dem for dem heart, dey talk say, “Den wetin this pikin go be?” Di hand of di Lord dey with am.
Im papa Zacharias, Holy Spirit fill am, and e prophesy, talk say,
“Blessed be di Lord, di God of Israel, because e don visit im people and bring redemption for dem;
and e don raise horn of salvation for us for di house of im servant David
as e talk by di mouth of im holy prophets wey don dey from long time ago,
salvation from our enemies, and from di hand of all wey hate us;
to show mercy to our papa dem, to remember im holy covenant,
di oath wey e swear to Abraham, our papa,
to grant us say, as dem don free us from di hand of our enemies, we go serve am without fear,
for holiness and righteousness before am all di days of our life.
And you, pikin, dem go call you prophet of di Most High, because you go waka before di Lord to prepare im ways,
to give im people knowledge of salvation by forgiveness of dem sins,
because of di tender mercy of our God, wey di dawn from high go visit us with,
to shine on di people wey dey sit for darkness and di shadow of death; to guide our feet enter di way of peace.”
Di pikin dey grow, dey become strong for spirit, and e dey di deserts until di day wey e show imself to Israel.
Now for those days, one decree come from Caesar Augustus say make dem register all di world.
Na di first registration be this, when Quirinius na governor of Syria.
Everybody go register, each person for im own town.
Joseph go up too from Galilee, from di town of Nazareth, go Judea, to David town, wey dem dey call Bethlehem, because e na from David house and family;
to register with Mary, wey dem don promise to marry am as wife, and e dey pregnant.
As dem dey there, di day reach wey e go born.
E born im first son. E wrap am with strips of cloth, and put am for feeding trough, because no space dey for dem for di inn.
Shepherds dey for di same country wey dey stay for field, dey watch dem flock for night.
Look, one angel of di Lord stand near dem, and di glory of di Lord shine round dem, and dem fear well well.
Di angel talk to dem say, “No fear, because look, I bring una Good News of great joy wey go be for all di people.
Because dem don born Savior for una today for David town, wey be Christ Lord.
Na this be di sign for una: una go find baby wey dem wrap with strips of cloth, dey lie for feeding trough.”
Suddenly, plenty of di heavenly army dey with di angel dey praise God, dey talk say,
“Glory to God for di highest, and for earth peace, good will to men.”
As di angels leave dem go di sky, di shepherds talk to each other say, “Make we go Bethlehem now, see this thing wey don happen, wey di Lord don make known to us.”
Dem come quick, find Mary and Joseph, and di baby dey lie for di feeding trough.
When dem see am, dem spread di word wey dem talk to dem about this pikin.
All di people wey hear am marvel for wetin di shepherds talk to dem.
But Mary keep all these words, dey think about dem for im heart.
Di shepherds go back, dey praise God and give am glory for all di things wey dem hear and see, just as dem tell dem.
When eight days don full for di pikin circumcision, dem call im name Jesus, wey di angel give before e enter im mama belle.
When di days of dem purification don full according to di law of Moses, dem carry am go up to Jerusalem, to present am to di Lord
as e dey write for di law of di Lord, “Every male wey open di womb go dey called holy to di Lord,”
and to offer sacrifice according to wetin dem talk for di law of di Lord, “Pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
Look, one man dey Jerusalem wey im name na Simeon. This man dey righteous and devout, dey wait for di consolation of Israel, and Holy Spirit dey on am.
Holy Spirit don reveal to am say e no go see death before e see di Christ of di Lord.
E come inside temple by di Spirit. As di parents bring di pikin Jesus come in, so that dem go do for am according to di custom of di law,
den e carry am for im arms, bless God, and talk say,
“Now Master, you dey release your servant in peace, according to your word;
because my eyes don see your salvation,
wey you don prepare before all peoples;
light to reveal to di nations, and di glory of your people Israel.”
Joseph and im mama dey marvel for di things wey dem talk about am,
and Simeon bless dem, talk to Mary, im mama, say, “Look, dem set this pikin for di falling and di rising of plenty for Israel, and for sign wey dem go speak against.
Yes, sword go pierce your own soul too, so that di thoughts of plenty hearts go dey revealed.”
One woman dey, Anna, prophetess, Phanuel daughter, from di tribe of Asher. E don old well well, after e don live with husband seven years from im virginity,
and e don dey widow for about 84 years. E no dey leave di temple, dey worship with fasting and petitions night and day.
E come up for that same hour, thank di Lord, and talk about am to all di people wey dey wait for redemption for Jerusalem.
When dem don finish all things wey di law of di Lord talk, dem go back Galilee, to dem own town, Nazareth.
Di pikin dey grow, dey become strong for spirit, wisdom dey fill am, and God grace dey on am.
Im parents dey go Jerusalem every year for di feast of Passover.
When e reach 12 years, dem go up Jerusalem according to di custom of di feast,
and when dem don finish di days, as dem dey return, di boy Jesus remain for Jerusalem. Joseph and im mama no know,
but dem think say e dey inside di group, dem waka one day journey, and dem dey look for am among dem relatives and friends.
When dem no find am, dem go back Jerusalem, dey look for am.
After three days dem find am for di temple, dey sit for middle of di teachers, dey listen to dem, and dey ask dem questions.
All di people wey hear am shock for im understanding and im answers.
When dem see am, dem shock; and im mama talk to am say, “My son, why you treat us like this? Look, your papa and I dey look for you with worry.”
E talk to dem say, “Why una dey look for me? Una no know say I must dey my Papa God house?”
Dem no understand di word wey e talk to dem.
E go down with dem, come Nazareth. E dey obey dem, and im mama keep all these words for im heart.
Jesus grow for wisdom and height, and for favor with God and men.

Now for di fifteenth year of di reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate na governor of Judea, Herod na tetrarch of Galilee, im brother Philip na tetrarch of di region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias na tetrarch of Abilene,
when Annas and Caiaphas dey as high priests, God word come to John, Zacharias son, for di wilderness.
E go all di region round Jordan, dey preach di baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
As e dey write for di book of di words of Isaiah di prophet, “Di voice of one wey dey shout for di wilderness, ‘Make una prepare di way for Lord. Make una straighten im paths.
Every valley go dey filled. Every mountain and hill go dey brought low. Di crooked go become straight, and di rough ways go smooth.
All flesh go see God salvation.’”
So e talk to di crowds wey go out to dey baptized by am, “Una vipers pikin dem, who warn una to run from di wrath wey dey come?
So bring forth fruits wey fit show repentance, and no begin talk among una say, ‘We get Abraham as our papa,’ because I tell una say God fit raise pikin dem for Abraham from these stones.
Even now di axe dey lie for di root of di trees. So every tree wey no bear good fruit dem go cut am down, throw am inside fire.”
Di crowds ask am, “Den wetin we go do?”
E answer dem, “Di person wey get two coats, make e give di one wey no get. Di person wey get food, make e do di same.”
Tax collectors come too to dey baptized, and dem talk to am say, “Teacher, wetin we must do?”
E talk to dem say, “No collect more than wetin dem set for una.”
Soldiers ask am too, talk say, “And we? Wetin we must do?” E talk to dem say, “No take anything from anybody by force, and no accuse anybody falsely. Be satisfied with your wages.”
As di people dey expect, and all men dey reason for dem heart about John, whether perhaps na im be di Christ,
John answer dem all, “Na true I dey baptize una with water, but one wey mighty pass me dey come, wey I no worthy to loose im sandal strap. E go baptize una with Holy Spirit and fire,
wey im winnowing fork dey im hand, and e go clean im threshing floor well, gather di wheat enter im barn; but di chaff e go burn am with fire wey no fit quench.”
Den with plenty other exhortations e preach Good News to di people,
but Herod di tetrarch, as John rebuke am for Herodias, im brother wife, and for all di evil things wey Herod do,
add this one more to dem all, say e lock John for prison.
Now e happen, when all di people don baptize, say Jesus don baptize too, and e dey pray. Di sky open,
and Holy Spirit come down for bodily form like dove on am; and one voice come from di sky, talk say, “You na my beloved Pikin. I dey pleased with you.”
Jesus imself, as e begin to teach, e dey about 30 years old, na Joseph son as dem think, wey be Heli son,
wey be Matthat son, wey be Levi son, wey be Melchi son, wey be Jannai son, wey be Joseph son,
wey be Mattathias son, wey be Amos son, wey be Nahum son, wey be Esli son, wey be Naggai son,
wey be Maath son, wey be Mattathias son, wey be Semein son, wey be Josech son, wey be Joda son,
wey be Joanan son, wey be Rhesa son, wey be Zerubbabel son, wey be Shealtiel son, wey be Neri son,
wey be Melchi son, wey be Addi son, wey be Cosam son, wey be Elmadam son, wey be Er son,
wey be Jose son, wey be Eliezer son, wey be Jorim son, wey be Matthat son, wey be Levi son,
wey be Simeon son, wey be Judah son, wey be Joseph son, wey be Jonam son, wey be Eliakim son,
wey be Melea son, wey be Menna son, wey be Mattatha son, wey be Nathan son, wey be David son,
wey be Jesse son, wey be Obed son, wey be Boaz son, wey be Salmon son, wey be Nahshon son,
wey be Amminadab son, wey be Arni son, wey be Hezron son, wey be Perez son, wey be Judah son,
wey be Jacob son, wey be Isaac son, wey be Abraham son, wey be Terah son, wey be Nahor son,
wey be Serug son, wey be Reu son, wey be Peleg son, wey be Eber son, wey be Shelah son,
wey be Cainan son, wey be Arphaxad son, wey be Shem son, wey be Noah son, wey be Lamech son,
wey be Methuselah son, wey be Enoch son, wey be Jared son, wey be Mahalaleel son, wey be Cainan son,
wey be Enos son, wey be Seth son, wey be Adam son, wey be God son.
Jesus, wey Holy Spirit full, return from Jordan, and di Spirit lead am for di wilderness
for 40 days, as di devil dey tempt am. E no chop anything for those days. After dem finish, hunger catch am.
Di devil talk to am say, “If you na God Pikin, command this stone make e turn bread.”
Jesus answer am, talk say, “E dey write, ‘Man no go live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”
Di devil carry am go up high mountain, show am all di kingdoms of di world for one moment.
Di devil talk to am say, “I go give you all this authority, and dem glory, because dem don give am to me; and I dey give am to anybody wey I want.
So if you go worship before me, e all go be yours.”
Jesus answer am, “Get behind me, Satan! Because e dey write, ‘You go worship di Lord your God, and na am only you go serve.’”
E carry am go Jerusalem, put am for di top of di temple, and talk to am say, “If you na God Pikin, throw yourself down from here,
because e dey write, ‘E go command im angels about you, to guard you;’
and, ‘Dem go carry you with dem hands, so that you no go knock your foot against stone.’”
Jesus answer am, “Dem don talk say, ‘You no go test di Lord your God.’”
When di devil don finish every temptation, e leave am until another time.
Jesus return with di power of di Spirit go Galilee, and news about am spread through all di region round.
E dey teach for dem synagogues, and everybody dey praise am.
E come Nazareth, wia dem don raise am. E enter di synagogue for Sabbath day as e dey do, and stand up to read.
Dem give am di book of Isaiah di prophet. E open di book, find di place wia e dey write,

“Di Spirit of di Lord dey on me, because e don anoint me to preach Good News to di poor. E don send me to heal di brokenhearted, to announce release to di captives, sight to di blind, to free di people wey dem crush,
and to announce di year wey di Lord go show favor.”
E close di book, give am back to di attendant, and sit down. Di eyes of all for di synagogue dey fix on am.
E begin tell dem, “Today, this Scripture don fulfill as una dey hear.”
All dey testify about am, and dem marvel for di gracious words wey dey come out of im mouth, and dem talk say, “No be Joseph son be this?”
E talk to dem say, “Without doubt una go tell me this parable, ‘Doctor, heal yourself! Anything wey we hear say dem do for Capernaum, do am here too for your hometown.’”
E talk say, “Na true I dey tell una, no prophet dey acceptable for im hometown.
But I dey tell una truly, plenty widows dey for Israel for di days of Elijah, when di sky shut three years and six months, when great famine come over all di land.
Dem no send Elijah to any of dem, except to Zarephath, for di land of Sidon, to one woman wey be widow.
Plenty people wey get leprosy dey for Israel for di time of Elisha di prophet, yet none of dem clean, except Naaman, di Syrian.”
Dem all full with anger for di synagogue as dem hear these things.
Dem get up, throw am out of di town, lead am go di brow of di hill wey dem build dem town on, so that dem go throw am down di cliff.
But e pass through di middle of dem, go im way.
E go down Capernaum, one town for Galilee. E dey teach dem for Sabbath day,
and dem shock for im teaching, because im word dey with authority.
For di synagogue one man dey wey get evil spirit, and e shout with loud voice,
“Ha! Wetin we get to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? You don come destroy us? I know who you be: di Holy One of God!”
Jesus rebuke am, talk say, “Keep quiet, and come out of am!” When di evil spirit don throw di man down for dem middle, e come out of am, without harm am.
Amazement catch all, and dem talk to each other say, “Wetin be this word? Because with authority and power e dey command di evil spirits, and dem dey come out!”
News about am spread to every place for di region round.
E get up from di synagogue, enter Simon house. Simon wife mama dey suffer with big fever, and dem beg am for di woman.
E stand over di woman, rebuke di fever; and e leave am. At once e get up serve dem.
When sun dey set, all di people wey get sick people with different sicknesses bring dem come to am; and e put hands on each one of dem, heal dem.
Evil spirits come out from plenty people too, dey shout, dey talk say, “You na Christ, God Pikin!” E rebuke dem, no allow dem talk, because dem know say na im be Christ.
When day break, e leave go one place wey nobody dey, and di crowds look for am, come to am, hold am so that e no go leave dem.
But e talk to dem say, “I must preach di Good News of God Kingdom to di other towns too. Na for this reason dem send me.”
E dey preach for di synagogues of Galilee.
